newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED ON THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED ON THURSDAY.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker against the U.S. dollar but closed firmer against other key currencies on Thursday, dealers said.
"Some people were selling (U.S. dollars) and we saw one foreign bank buying Zimbabwe dollars," one dealer said.
"But we also had some outflows which proved bigger than the inflows," he added in explanation of the local unit's fall against the U.S. dollar.
The Zimbabwe dollar ended the day at 11.3175/3275 against the U.S. unit from Wednesday's 11.3100/3200 but firmed against sterling to 18.4000/4200 from 18.4050/4270.
It was also quoted stronger on the mark at 6.5800/6000 compared to 6.5970/6050 and at 2.5300/5500 versus the rand from 2.5440/5480.
